name: tests-only-fscan-resumable-service-scan-checkpoints
instr:
fscan cannot resume TCP service scans across fresh sessions without repeating delivered results or protocol work. Build the durable checkpoint storage that opt-in resumable scans will use. `PluginOption` in `github.com/shadow1ng/fscan/plugins/services` is `func(*PluginRegistration)`; `WithResumableScan` returns one. `CheckpointManager` in `github.com/shadow1ng/fscan/common` provides session-owned access configured by `CheckpointConfig.Path`.

`OpenFileStore(path)` keeps its records in files inside the directory `path`, so committed records survive closing the store and opening it again; a location that is an existing regular file is rejected. The store atomically replaces generation-controlled records keyed by plugin, target, port, and scan configuration fingerprint. Stale generations must never overwrite or delete progress; they fail with `ErrGenerationConflict`. `ScanSession.Checkpoints().Commit` commits through the store at the session's `CheckpointConfig.Path`.

Wiring checkpoints into the scanner (restoring continuations during scans, skipping terminal tasks, committing or deleting scan progress) is out of scope. A cancelled service scan never reports success. Preserve existing registrations, protocol outputs, counters, errors, and filesystem behavior, including disabled-brute scans. Existing `RegisterPluginWithPorts` code must compile unchanged.
